limits: Synthetic login state; native Docker, PostgreSQL authority and Vue UI fixtures exercised separately. No third-party SSO account or deployed uninterrupted UI/API/Runner journey certified.
Default gates remain off; production V2 activation remains rejected. Working DB/schema/settings not changed.
Single-host durable independent signed SQLite journal shared by API/reaper. Multi-host coherence not certified.
Restore must retain the newest journal. Rolling back both journal and DB before a fresh process cannot be detected. Uncertain continuity requires old storage-key invalidation and fresh consent.
Actual host backup/restore, key rotation, monitoring, Docker mutation settlement/reset, public isolation and EUR10 infrastructure capacity/budget remain launch gates.
Cookies/localStorage only. IndexedDB, sessionStorage, profile/passkey import/export, Android/Firebase and iOS remain deferred.
